name: Finnmark FD-3 Full Spectrum Infrared Sauna | 4-Person Infrared Sauna
description: Description Create a wellness sanctuary for the whole family or simply indulge in the luxury of extra space. The Finnmark FD-3 is the ultimate upgrade for your home, offering a spacious 3-4 person cabin for shared relaxation. This sauna delivers the same industry-leading technology as its smaller siblings, reaching a true maximum temperature of 170°F with its advanced dual-heater system. Built with premium, non-toxic materials and backed by a comprehensive 10-Year Warranty, it's a lasting investment in your home. To power its larger size and incredible heat, this model uses a 240v outlet, ensuring it gets to temperature quickly and efficiently every single time. Finnmark vs. Others Features This sauna is engineered from the ground up for performance, comfort, and longevity. Here’s a look at the features that make the difference. Advanced Dual-Wave Heating: The FD-3 pairs powerful, UL-listed Spectrum Plus™ heaters (for deep penetration) with Spectrum Carbon 360° panels (for full-body immersion). This combination creates an intense, enveloping heat that feels like it's coming from every direction. High Emissivity & Low EMF: Its heaters are not only powerful but also highly efficient at radiating infrared heat. They've also been rigorously tested to ensure ultra-low EMF levels, so you can relax with total peace of mind. Antimicrobial Canadian Cedar Interior: You want your wellness space to be, well, clean. Finnmark uses beautiful Western Canadian Cedar because it naturally resists mold and bacteria. It smells amazing and keeps this sanctuary fresh session after session. Smart, Insulated Construction: The sauna features high-quality, double-walled construction packed with non-toxic wool insulation. This means it heats up faster, holds its temperature steady, and is more energy-efficient. Electrical Requirements To provide powerful, consistent heat to its spacious cabin, the FD-3 uses a 240v power source. Here’s what you need to know: Outlet Needed: This sauna uses a 240v, 15a NEMA 6-15P plug. This is a common outlet type used for larger home appliances like electric clothes dryers or ovens. Why 240v?: Using a higher voltage allows this large sauna to heat up quickly and maintain its 170°F temperature much more efficiently than a standard 120v outlet could support. Installation: If your home doesn't already have this type of outlet in the desired location, a licensed electrician can typically install one easily. What's Included No surprise trips to the hardware store. Here’s everything that arrives at your door, ready for you to build your personal oasis. Sauna Wall, Floor & Ceiling Panels Pre-Hung 8mm Tempered Glass Door Ergonomic Backrest & Sauna Bench All Infrared Heater Panels & Red Light Therapy Units Built-in LCD Touchscreen Controller 2.0 Bluetooth Audio with 6" HiFi Speakers All Cables, Screws, and Power Supply Unit Removable & Adjustable Feet (for uneven floors) Comprehensive 10-Year Warranty & ETL Certification Specifications Model FD-3 External Materials Thermo-Aspen Interior Materials Western Canadian Cedar Volts 240 Watts 3150 Amperage 15 Phase Single Plug Type NEMA 6-15P Outlet 240v 15a Maximum Temperature 170F Interior Dimensions 67"W x 41"D x 70"H Exterior Dimensions 72"W x 46"D x 78"H Room Volume 111.3 cu. ft. Door Dimensions 23.625"W x 67.875"H Door Handle Dimensions 1.875"W x 11.625"H Glass Thickness 8mm Product Weight 488 lbs Shipping Dimensions 36"W X 78"D Shipping Weight 536 lbs W/48 lb Pallet Assembly, Cost & Documents Even for a large sauna, Finnmark made the process incredibly simple. Assembly: The process is the same as the smaller models. The panels are designed to latch together easily. Grab a friend (it's a two-person job to be safe) and a screwdriver for the door handle. You’ll have it set up in about 60-90 minutes. Operating Cost: For a sauna of this size and power, it's incredibly efficient. Based on the average US electricity rate, a full one-hour session typically costs around 35 to 45 cents. Owner's Manual
